confirmedProblems.failure: Unchecked double→size_t and wrapped rowBytes*height bypassed iOS encoder storage validation; RGBA descriptor dimensions ignored.
confirmedProblems.before: Actual JSC call with BGRA/RGBA stride2**58,height64,one-byte data reached encodePixels and returned Encoder not prepared rather than storage rejection. Wrong RGBA dimensions also reached encodePixels.
confirmedProblems.after: Finite exactly representable integers, checked products, exact dimensions/ArrayBuffer views and nanosecond timestamp bounds;100k randomized valid layouts and extreme invalid cases pass.

confirmedProblems.failure: Disposed sync extractor and decoder could restart a reader through decode/start/seek.
confirmedProblems.before: Actual local 10-frame H264 fixture: start→dispose→decode(0) reopened decoder and allocated owned samples; closed decoder seek→advance returned a new frame.
confirmedProblems.after: Serialized monotonic closed state, idempotent start, disposed extractor rejection, closed decoder no-op and stale in-flight batches dropped.

confirmedProblems.failure: AVPlayer copied pixel buffer leaked and frame timestamp advanced if constructing a frame lease threw.
confirmedProblems.evidence: copyPixelBuffer supplied+1 and CVPixelBufferRelease followed the throwing MemoryBudget/frame construction.
confirmedProblems.after: Scoped adopting CoreVideo owner releases on every exception; lastFrameDrawn changes only after success.1000 budget-refusal cycles on an actual two-buffer pool do not exhaust it.

confirmedProblems.failure: Encoder preparation started writer/audio before reserving pool and failures left partial resources until disposal. Logical packed strides undercounted padded CoreVideo allocation.
confirmedProblems.after: Transactional preparation reserves/probes/resizes actual three-buffer capacity before writer creation, rolls back on every failure. Real34x34 pool reservation equals actual CoreVideo storage×3; budget refusal creates no output file.

confirmedProblems.failure: Concurrent encode/finish and disposal could free pool/writer resources in use.
confirmedProblems.after: Serialized operations, cancellation announced before lock acquisition, interruptible bounded waits;30 real encode/dispose races return reservations promptly. Async completion uses explicit strongly owned NSError storage.

confirmedProblems.failure: Preview/player metadata, clock, prepare/dispose and frame timestamps accessed shared state without consistent locking; late seeks could reopen released decoder.
confirmedProblems.after: Shared state serialization, atomic closure announced first, weak pending seek/track-load callbacks and explicit cancelPendingSeeks/cancelLoading. Real iOS SDK compilation passed; full physical-device player stress still requires execution.

confirmedProblems.failure: A short forward seek discarded prefetched samples while keeping their already-advanced reader.
confirmedProblems.before: Actual iPhone XCTest:seek0.1s kept frame0 instead of frame3.
confirmedProblems.after: Forward read-on retains queued samples and generation; real host H264 preview regression9 successive tenth-second seeks returns exact alternating colors under ASan/UBSan.

confirmedProblems.failure: Preview seeks replaced a reader on the caller thread while a stale decoder tick advanced it; paused seeks relied solely on display-link delivery.
confirmedProblems.before: Actual iPhone:paused seek0.5s stayed frame0 instead of15; final scrub4.2s had no c frame.
confirmedProblems.after: Desired clock and generation update immediately; one coalesced serial decoder task applies reader seek and advancement, explicitly scheduled by seek/frame polling. Stale generations cannot publish new acquired frames. All50 current-source XCTest cases passed on the actual iOS Simulator, including paused seeks and scrubs.

confirmedProblems.failure: Slow-motion parity test retained consumed native leases; odd-size H264 test source was silently encoded with even dimensions.
confirmedProblems.before: Actual iPhone slow-motion stopped at frame1 on its third request. Local AVFoundation probe:H264 requested1279x719 but coded/decoded1278x718; JPEG movie coded/decoded1279x719.
confirmedProblems.after: Slow-motion returns each consumed lease after CPU snapshot while retaining every one of270 exact timeline frame assertions. The locally generated JPEG1279x719 movie is bundled with XCTest; its coded dimensions and all30 requested-frame pixel/index/dimension checks pass on Simulator. Host AVFoundation independently validated its30 exact sample PTS. No production assertion weakened.

confirmedProblems.failure: Decoder release/seek could call AVAssetReader.cancelReading concurrently with copyNextSampleBuffer, contrary to Apple SDK contract. RN preview teardown exposed SIGSEGV in FigVisualContext on Simulator.
confirmedProblems.evidence: Actual Simulator crash report ReactNativeSkiaWebGPUVideoExample-2026-10-06-165906.ips; AVAssetReader.h lines215-223 explicitly forbid this concurrency. The same4K movie decodes correctly with all exact production output options in an isolated Simulator executable.
confirmedProblems.after: Dedicated mutex serializes reader reads/seeks/cancellation; atomic closure announcement interrupts read-on batches between samples before waiting for currentcopy.30 actual host decode/scaling1280x720/dispose races pass ASan/UBSan, bounded closure and final zero reservations. canAddOutput/startReading failures checked; valid empty/past-end ranges return no reader without an initialization error.

confirmedProblems.failure: Completed preview clock reverted to its previous paused position, usually zero, when isPlaying became false.
confirmedProblems.evidence: The completed branch changed isPlaying without updating pausePosition; getCurrentTime uses pausePosition while paused.
confirmedProblems.after: Non-loop completion preserves composition.duration as pausePosition. The existing eager playback XCTest awaits complete, asserts isPlaying=false and duration, and checks that clock again after 100 ms. play() at completion restarts via seekTo(0); repeated play during playback is idempotent. The same concrete XCTest verifies progressing replay clock, frames from the first clip, and continuity after repeated play; final Simulator run passed.

confirmedProblems.failure: Restarting playback at completion without audio used the preserved end position, and repeated play during active playback reset its clock.
confirmedProblems.evidence: play() used pausePosition as its start offset, cleared it, and had no isPlaying guard. Only its audio branch sought to zero at the end.
confirmedProblems.after: Already-playing calls return without rewinding; completed playback calls seekTo(0) so its clock, decoder generation and pending seek all restart together. The strengthened existing eager playback XCTest passed on Simulator.

confirmedProblems.failure: Synchronous Skia export setup, native-image import and cleanup were outside the drawing autorelease pool on a persistent Worklets background thread.
confirmedProblems.evidence: Worklets0.11.3 AsyncQueueImpl.cpp runs job() on a detached std::thread without an Apple autorelease pool; export previously pooled only draw. Native encoder/decoder methods already use their own runPooled wrapper.
confirmedProblems.after: All synchronous setup/decode/import/draw/finalize/cleanup operations have explicit scopes. No await or async processor continuation runs inside a scope. Six real Babel serialized-worklet regressions verify depth, balanced errors/cancellation and async boundaries. The actual RSS effect requires post-fix app measurement.
